tools.name: find_integration
tools.description: Explains GCNA's Phone System app for Nextcloud or Odoo: what it does, what the Vodia PBX adds (including next to Nextcloud Talk), requirements, where to install it and how buying works. Omit platform to get both.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Current Phone System plans (by number of users) with monthly and annual prices, from GCNA's live catalogue. Pass the buyer's country (ISO code such as DE) for their currency.

tools.name: plan_purchase
tools.description: For a team size and platform, names the smallest fitting plan and the exact steps to buy it. The purchase itself happens in the Nextcloud or Odoo app: the buyer confirms their e-mail with a code and pays on Stripe's page. No checkout is started here.

tools.name: create_account_link
tools.description: Returns the page where a business user creates their GCNA account themselves (name, work e-mail, password, then a confirmation link by e-mail). A Phone System purchase in Nextcloud or Odoo creates the account too, so this is only needed to use GCNA's other services first.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_account_link" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
